[SWS_DM_01215] Extend the DynamicAccessList
⌈
If the application
calls the ara::diag::ClientAuthenticationHandle::Append method of the
class ara::diag::ClientAuthenticationHandle, the Diagnostic Server
instance shall extend the DynamicAccessList of the authenticated client with the
DynamicAccessList passed by the application.
